qa_pair.question: Inspect the installed plugins, then inspect the Lemo rendering operation. Which native parameter selects the WebGL backend?
Inspect the project configuration schema and Lemo rendering schema. Which configuration field prevents a scene from overriding a chosen render width?
Inspect the animation pipeline and Lemo operation permissions. In which pipeline stage can Lemo render scene clips?

Inspect the Lemo operation and its production instruction. Does it replace the final OpenMontage composition runtime or produce intermediate scene clips? Answer with the declared output artifact type.
Inspect the project configuration and route schemas. Which routing mode requires a pinned operation for each planned stage?
Inspect the plugin operation catalogue and the Lemo schema. What is the maximum number of workers allowed for one Lemo render?
Inspect the Lemo schema and its production instruction. Which mode checks whether text remains visible long enough to read?
Inspect the configuration schema and the factory guide. Which field limits simultaneous jobs within one project?
Inspect the animation manifest and canonical artifact schema list. What is the canonical artifact produced by the assets stage?
Inspect the factory guide and configuration schema. Is max_job_estimate_usd a provider billing cap or an estimate threshold?
